Hunger · Want · A Meal That Never Comes

It arrived starving, from somewhere that apparently starves gods, and found nothing in this drowned, dead world worth eating. So it settled for the next best thing: lending its hunger out, one cultist at a time, in exchange for the strength that hunger carries. Followers describe an ever-present, low-grade craving for something they can never quite name — and a strength that shows up exactly when they need to take something by force.

Gluttoneth's shrines are always near food, however scarce — granaries, ration lines, butcher stalls — not because it wants an offering, but because it likes to watch.
